message.content:
Here is the evaluation for each image:

**Image 1 (About section)**
(a) Yes, all text is readable with dark text on a light background.  
(b) No, there is no text that is too light or invisible.  
(c) The layout looks professional with a clean hierarchy and clear typography.

**Image 2 (Services section)**
(a) Yes, all text is clearly readable against the white cards and background.  
(b) No, all text maintains sufficient contrast for easy reading.  
(c) It presents a professional appearance using organized grid cards and consistent icons.

**Image 3 (Contact section)**
(a) Yes, the form labels, input placeholders, and body text are fully readable.  
(b) No, although some placeholder text is grey, it remains legible.  
(c) The design looks professional with a clear call-to-action button and structured layout.

**Image 4 (Footer)**
(a) Yes, all contact details, links, and copyright text are easily readable.  
(b) No, the dark text provides excellent contrast on the light footer area.  
(c) This looks professional with well-organized columns and clear contact information.

**Image 5 (Products page - Cables)**
(a) Yes, the product titles and descriptions are readable, though the hero text uses white for contrast against the image.  
(b) No invisible text, though the large background numbers ("01", "02") are intentionally faint.  
(c) The page looks professional with a modern filter sidebar and clean product card design.
